hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$root" ] || [ ! -f "$root/Makefile" ]; then exit 0; fi; cd "$root" || exit 0; out=$(make check 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then reason=$(printf "%s" "$out" | tail -60 | jq -Rs .); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":%s}}' "$reason"; fi
hooks.statusMessage: make check (R-9: DoD = зелёный CI) перед коммитом...
